Target files: lib/crewai-tools/src/crewai_tools/tools/mongodb_vector_search_tool/vector_search.py, lib/crewai-tools/tests/tools/test_mongodb_vector_search_tool.py. `MongoDBVectorSearchTool` advertised `BROWSERBASE_API_KEY` and `BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID` in its `env_vars` metadata, apparently copied from the Browserbase tool. The tool does not read those variables; it requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` or an Azure OpenAI configuration for embeddings. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9622)

The request flag never reached the provider: `kcChatInvoker` built `models.ChatConfig` without it, and `ChatConfig` had no JSON-mode field at all, so the shared ... (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/22648)

workarounds.symptom: Bedrock S3 upload path is unreachable: `_should_upload` checks `supports_file_upload` before `prefer_upload`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(files): let prefer_upload enable Bedrock S3 uploads. Target files: lib/crewai-files/src/crewai_files/resolution/resolver.py, lib/crewai-files/tests/test_resolver.py. `_get_resolver_config()` enables `prefer_upload` for Bedrock when `CREWAI_BEDROCK_S3_BUCKET` is set, and both `BedrockFileUploader` and `BedrockFormatter`'s `FileReference` -> `s3Location` branch exist to serve that path. However, `FileResolver._should_upload()` returned `False` for every provider without `supports_file_upload`, which includes `BEDROCK_CONS... (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9624)

workarounds.symptom: Transformers v5.23.0: enable_expert_parallel=True / ep_size=tp_size, tp_plan={} fails at load with "tp_size=N was requested, but ... has no tp_plan"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Allow expert parallelism alone with `tp_plan={}`. Target files: src/transformers/distributed/mixin.py. Since v5.23.0, you can no longer load an MoE model with expert parallelism only (experts split across ranks, everything else replicated). Both ways of asking for it fail: The error is wrong: the model has a TP plan. The user passed `tp_plan={}` on purpose to turn TP off. A recent check sees the empty plan and assumes the model has none. The check now accepts an explicit `tp_plan={}`. Models with no TP plan at all ... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50996)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Auto-resize leaves narrow images above provider dimensions
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(files): preserve narrow dimensions when resizing images. Target files: lib/crewai-files/src/crewai_files/processing/transformers.py, lib/crewai-files/tests/processing/test_processor.py, lib/crewai-files/tests/processing/test_transformers.py. Aspect-ratio resizing can truncate the shorter dimension to zero. A direct resize raises a Pillow error, while `FileProcessor("anthropic").process()` logs that failure and returns the original oversized image. A 1×16000 PNG therefore remains above the built-in 8000-pixel height limit. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9605)

workarounds.symptom: [Data] DataSource V2 silently skips files whose size is unknown (e.g. HTTP without `Content-Length`)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Data] Read files of unknown size on DataSource V2. Target files: python/ray/data/_internal/datasource_v2/common/line_chunk_file_indexer.py, python/ray/data/_internal/datasource_v2/common/listing_utils.py, python/ray/data/_internal/datasource_v2/common/non_sampling_file_indexer.py. DataSource V2 now reads files whose size the filesystem doesn't report, such as files on an HTTP server that sends no `Content-Length`. Before, V2 dropped them, and `read_text` sent every HTTP read to V1 to avoid that. . (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/68397)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Confluence sync fails for long UTF-8 page names — invalid byte truncation causes MySQL Error 1366
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve UTF-8 when truncating synced filenames. Target files: internal/service/document/sync_document.go, internal/service/document/sync_document_test.go. Long Confluence page names can fail to sync because the shared filename formatter slices at a fixed byte offset. A split UTF-8 character leaves an invalid byte sequence in the document name, which MySQL rejects. (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/22645)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: PyFloat64 does not match Python json.dumps: 1.0 becomes 1 and 1000000.0 becomes 1e+06 in Go API responses
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(common): make PyFloat64 print floats like Python json.dumps. Target files: internal/common/number.go, internal/common/number_test.go. `common.PyFloat64` is documented to print floats the way Python's `json.dumps` does, but its `MarshalJSON` used `strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'g', -1, 64)`. Go's `'g'` drops the `.0` of whole numbers and switches to exponent form once the decimal exponent reaches 6, while Python keeps `.0` and only uses exponent form below 1e-4 and from 1e16. So `ConvertFloatsToPyFormat` (used for the `POST ... (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/22638)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(calculator): report unknown conversions instead of a parser error. The calculator SKILL.md troubleshooting table says an unsupported conversion reports `Unknown conversion` and lists the supported units, but `calc.py` never printed that. A request in the `<number> <unit> to <unit>` shape with a pair outside `CONVERSIONS` made `try_conversion()` return `None`, so `main()` passed it to ... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/859)

workarounds.symptom: HyperbrowserLoadTool: `params` is required in the tool schema although typed and described as optional
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): make HyperbrowserLoadTool params optional in its schema. Target files: lib/crewai-tools/src/crewai_tools/tools/hyperbrowser_load_tool/hyperbrowser_load_tool.py, lib/crewai-tools/tests/tools/test_hyperbrowser_load_tool_schema.py. `HyperbrowserLoadToolSchema.params` is typed `dict | None` and described as optional, but has no default, so pydantic treats it as required. The generated tool schema lists it under `required` and a call without it fails validation. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9646)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Vendor content-safety rejections are misclassified and never fail over to other VLM credentials
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(vlm): classify content-filtered completions as safety errors. Target files: bot/vikingbot/providers/vlm_adapter.py, openviking/models/model_error.py, openviking/models/vlm/backends/litellm_vlm.py. 模型服务可以返回 HTTP 200，并通过 `choices[0].finish_reason` 表示输出被内容审核拦截。此前普通 VLM 调用可能把这种响应当作空字符串或不完整的正文继续处理，导致调用方丢失真正的失败原因。 (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/8034)

Target files: server/worldmonitor/news/v1/_attempts.ts, tests/digest-attempt-outcomes.test.mts, tests/news-feed-background-refresh.test.mts. (Ref: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor/pull/11135)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: service_tier parameter rejected by Vertex AI (v1 API) with 400 for all values
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(vertex_ai): send service_tier to Vertex Gemini as tier headers. Target files: litellm/cost_calculator.py, litellm/litellm_core_utils/service_tier_utils.py, litellm/llms/gemini/chat/transformation.py. The `serviceTier` body field is accepted by Vertex AI (no 400) but does not activate tier routing. The `X-Vertex-AI-LLM-Shared-Request-Type` header is what actually routes to shared rate-limit pools with priority/flex enforcement. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/34959)

workarounds.symptom: Channel membership follow returns a one-shot receipt for invalid arguments
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): frame invalid follow arguments as stream failures. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/history-read.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/command.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/channel-members.ts. A JSON history follow with a missing option value or an unknown option returned a one-shot command receipt. A JSON channel membership follow did the same when it refused an invalid argument such as `--purge`. In both cases, a stream reader missed the error and end records it was waiting for. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/9332)
